title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify that the light is red-shifted.

title: Use of Fresnel's Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should reference Fresnel's equation for the speed of light in a moving medium.

title: Wavelength Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly derive the wavelength of light in water using the index of refraction.

title: Frequency Change Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the derivation of the frequency change as observed by the fish.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid incorrect sign errors in the frequency change calculation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Understanding of Red-Shift
description: Optional Criteria: The student should explain the concept of red-shift in the context of the problem.
